system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: ODYSSEY OUTCOMES NCT01663402 - ODYSSEY Outcomes: Evaluation of Cardiovascular Outcomes After an Acute Coronary Syndrome During Treatment With Alirocumab
Investigational drug: alirocumab
Document: A phase III randomized trial evaluating alirocumab 300 mg every 4 weeks as monotherapy or add-on to statin: ODYSSEY CHOICE I (journal, published 2016-08-31, source pmid:27639753)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
A phase III randomized trial evaluating alirocumab 300 mg every 4 weeks as monotherapy or add-on to statin: ODYSSEY CHOICE I

BACKGROUND AND AIMS: In previous phase III studies, the PCSK9 monoclonal antibody alirocumab was administered at doses of 75 or 150 mg every 2 weeks (Q2W). CHOICE I (NCT01926782) evaluated 300 mg every 4 weeks (Q4W) in patients on either maximally tolerated statin or no statin, both ± other lipid-lowering therapies. METHODS: CHOICE I included patients with hypercholesterolemia at moderate-to-very-high cardiovascular risk. Patients were randomized to alirocumab 300 mg Q4W, 75 mg Q2W (calibrator arm), or placebo for 48 weeks, with dose adjustment for either alirocumab arm to 150 mg Q2W at Week (W) 12 if at W8 LDL-C levels were >70/100 mg/dL (1.8/2.6 mmol/L) depending on cardiovascular risk or LDL-C reduction was <30% from baseline. Co-primary endpoints were percent LDL-C change from baseline to W24, and to time-averaged LDL-C over W21-24. RESULTS: Approximately two-thirds of randomized patients were receiving statins. At W12, 14.7% (no statin) and 19.3% (statin) of patients receiving alirocumab 300 mg Q4W required dose adjustment. At W24, significant LDL-C reductions from baseline were observed with alirocumab 300 mg Q4W: mean differences were -52.7% (no statin; placebo: -0.3%) and -58.8% (statin; placebo: -0.1%). Average LDL-C reductions from baseline to W21-24 were also significantly greater with alirocumab 300 mg Q4W vs. placebo in patients not receiving (-56.9% vs. -1.6%) and receiving statin (-65.8% vs. -0.8%). Treatment-emergent adverse event rates ranged from 61.1 to 75.0% (placebo) and 71.5 to 78.1% (alirocumab 300 mg Q4W). CONCLUSIONS: Alirocumab 300 mg Q4W is a viable additional treatment option in patients requiring LDL-C-lowering.
--- END ---

Extract the facts.
